Now, substituting \(d = \frac{a^2 - 10ac}{11}\) into \(cd = -11b\):
\[ c \left( \frac{a^2 - 10ac}{11} \right) = -11 \left( 10c - a \right) \]
\[ \frac{c(a^2 - 10ac)}{11} = -110c + 11a \]
\[ c(a^2 - 10ac) = -1210c + 121a \]
